headline: Retiree Who Learned to Swim Saves Drowning Man Half Her Age
meta_description: A 71-year-old woman in China's Anhui Province, who only learned to swim after retiring, rescued a man from the water without hesitation—then tried to disappear.
summary_short: A 71-year-old fitness enthusiast in Suixi County, China, rescued a drowning man using skills she'd acquired just years earlier in retirement.
body:
When 71-year-old Liu Defang heard someone shout that a man had fallen into the water near a bridge in Suixi County, Anhui Province, she did not pause to consider the risks. The white-haired fitness enthusiast, who had only learned to swim a few years after retiring from her job, waded into the water without hesitation. A bystander threw her a rigid life preserver, and Liu used it to reach the man and try to support him—though he resisted her efforts. Despite being more than twice his age, she managed to get control of him and drag him to shore, where locals helped pull them both out. Exhausted from the ordeal, Liu simply wanted to leave. She hoped no one had noticed her involvement, fearing her family would worry.

But local police had other plans. They released surveillance footage from traffic cameras, hoping someone would identify the rescuer. The video went viral on Chinese social media, drawing hundreds of comments praising her courage. Inevitably, her brother recognized her in the footage—the very person Liu had most wanted to keep in the dark. "My brother scolded me severely," she recalled. "He said, 'You are already over 70 years old. How dare you jump into the river to save others?'" Her daughter shared his fears.

Yet Liu, who practices yoga and maintains an active lifestyle, was unmoved by their worry. What struck her most was the man's apparent desperation. Though she never got the chance to speak with him after the rescue, she carried a quiet wish: that he might one day understand that difficulties always pass in time, and that life—precious and fragile—deserves to be cherished, not abandoned.
quick_facts: 71-year-old woman from Suixi County, Anhui Province, China
Learned to swim only a few years after retiring
Rescued a man who had jumped from a bridge
Video went viral on Chinese social media platforms
Family only discovered her heroics through surveillance footage
